name: Paper Cookies!
source:
"Are you okay?"

Is the first thing you hear upon opening your eyes to an unfamiliar room, the human-sized rabbit (?) offers you cookies with a concerned face. What is this place? why can't you remember anything and why is he trying to make you stay??

[Edited from [url=https://goattony.itch.io/paper-cookies]itch.io[/url]]
